description: Check interaction states in a stylesheet. Pass `css` (free) or a public `url` (Pro). Finds links, buttons, inputs, selects, summaries and classes that look interactive (btn, link, tab, toggle, switch, checkbox, chip, dropdown, form-control and others) or that already have a hover or focus rule, then lists for each which of :hover, :focus-visible (or :focus), :active, :disabled and aria or checked states have styles. A missing focus-visible style is high severity; a global :focus-visible rule counts for everything. Flags every rule that sets outline to none or 0 where no :focus or :focus-visible rule for the same element draws a ring, shadow or border instead (the :focus:not(:focus-visible) pattern is allowed).

css.description: CSS text to read (a stylesheet, or several concatenated). Free up to 100,000 characters; Pro up to 2,000,000.

url.description: Pro only. Public page whose linked and inline stylesheets are fetched (up to 12 sheets, 5 MB).

name: check_state_coverage
title: State coverage check
